jobsnearme: a lane that merges main after its build must declare each spec's scope.head at the build commit, or check:scope --all charges main's merged docs (e.g. go-live-plan.md) to the spec. Editing any test in an e2e file makes test:e2e:ci's headroom gate grade the whole file, so a long fixed-wait test in it may need test.slow().
